# Seoul boundary data attribution

File: `src/data/seoul-2013.geo.json` (unmodified download).

Source: [southkorea/seoul-maps](https://github.com/southkorea/seoul-maps), `kostat/2013/json/seoul_municipalities_geo_simple.json`.

Contributor: Lucy Park (http://lucypark.kr). Upstream source: KOSTAT administrative division geodata for Census, 2013. The repository states Apache License v2.0 in its README. A copy is stored as `apache-2.0.txt` in this directory. These simplified historical boundaries are used for development and are explicitly dated in the UI; they are not asserted to be current administrative boundaries.
